# proxmox_guest_mtunnel (Data Source)

Opens a migration tunnel through `/nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/mtunnel`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_guest_mtunnel" "t" {
  type = "qemu"
  node = "pve-1"
  vmid = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `bridges` (List of String)
- `storages` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `socket` (String)
- `ticket` (String, Sensitive)
- `upid` (String)
